news.titleEn: Stocks fall as August jobs report surprises to the upside
news.conclusionEn: U.S. employers added 162,000 jobs in August, far above the roughly 53,000 economists expected, with unemployment steady at 4.1%; the Dow fell 271.86 points (0.51%) to 53,414.25, the S&P 500 lost 0.38% to 7,718.60 and the Nasdaq dropped 0.29% to 26,506.99 as investors raised the odds of a Federal Reserve rate hike.
news.conclusionZh: 8月美国非农新增16.2万人远超预期，美股全线走低。
news.whyEn: The hot labor data pushes the Fed toward a possible rate hike at its Sept. 15-16 meeting, lifting Treasury yields and pressuring equities, mortgage rates and borrowing costs around the world.
news.whyZh: 强劲数据令美联储9月可能加息，推高美债收益率并施压全球股市与融资成本。
news.detailEn: The August gain was one of the strongest of the year, led by hiring at bars and restaurants, while information-sector jobs fell, partly reflecting AI-driven efficiency. Average hourly earnings rose 0.3% on the month and about 3.1% over the year, keeping wage growth firm. Traders lifted the market-implied probability of a September Fed hike toward 55-60% from roughly half earlier in the week, and the 2-year Treasury yield climbed to its highest since early 2025. Attention now turns to next week's U.S. consumer price data, the last major input before the Fed decides on Sept. 16. A hike would be unusual against a slowing economy but reflects officials' worry that oil-driven inflation is proving sticky.
news.detailZh: 8月新增就业为今年最强劲之一，酒吧餐饮业带动招聘，信息行业岗位减少，部分反映AI带来的效率提升。平均时薪环比涨0.3%、同比约涨3.1%，工资增长依然坚挺。交易员将9月美联储加息概率从周初约五成上调至55%至60%，两年期美债收益率升至2025年初以来最高。市场焦点转向下周美国CPI数据，这是美联储9月16日决议前最后的关键参考。在经济放缓背景下加息并不寻常，反映出官员担忧油价推动的通胀难以消退。

news.titleEn: Global bond rout deepens as Japan's 10-year yield hits 3% for the first time since 1996
news.conclusionEn: Japan's 10-year government bond yield reached 3% for the first time since 1996, UK 10-year gilt yields rose to about 5.25% (a post-2008 high), and German and U.S. long-term yields also climbed to multi-year peaks in a synchronized sell-off.
news.conclusionZh: 日本10年期国债收益率触及3%，为1996年以来首次。
news.whyEn: The worldwide jump in yields raises borrowing costs for governments and companies, reflects sticky inflation and heavy debt issuance, and tightens financial conditions even before any central bank acts.
news.whyZh: 全球收益率同步跳升，抬高各国政府与企业融资成本，反映通胀顽固、债务高企。
news.detailEn: The latest leg of the sell-off blends record government debt issuance, an oil-price shock that has revived inflation fears, and expectations that central banks keep policy tighter for longer. Japan is especially exposed because its government debt tops 200% of GDP, so rising rates sharply increase debt-service costs. Higher long-term yields ripple into mortgages, corporate loans and emerging-market financing, and they pull money out of equities toward safer fixed income. Stock markets fell in tandem this week as the 'higher-for-longer' narrative took hold. Investors are watching whether the Bank of Japan and other central banks intervene or signal comfort with the moves.
news.detailZh: 本轮抛售叠加了创纪录的政府债券发行、重燃通胀担忧的油价冲击，以及市场对央行更长时间维持紧缩的预期。日本尤其脆弱，其政府债务超过GDP的200%，利率上升会大幅推高偿债成本。长端收益率走高会传导至房贷、企业贷款和新兴市场融资，并促使资金撤出股市转向更安全的固定收益。本周股市随之同步下跌，「更高更久」的叙事占据上风。投资者正关注日本央行等是否会干预或对当前走势表态。

news.titleEn: Oil prices set for weekly gain as U.S.-Iran hostilities intensify
news.conclusionEn: Brent crude traded around $95.52 a barrel and WTI near $91.36, with Brent up roughly 7.6% on the week — its biggest weekly gain since July — after renewed U.S.-Iran strikes and attacks on tankers near the Strait of Hormuz.
news.conclusionZh: 布伦特原油周涨约7.6%至95美元，美伊冲突升级。
news.whyEn: About a fifth of the world's seaborne oil moves through the Strait of Hormuz, so a lasting risk premium feeds straight into global inflation, fuel costs and central-bank rate decisions.
news.whyZh: 霍尔木兹海峡承运全球约五分之一海运石油，油价溢价直接推高通胀与利率压力。
news.detailEn: The U.S. carried out fresh strikes on Iran this week after about a month of relative calm, and Tehran retaliated by targeting U.S. bases and vessels transiting Hormuz. Iran fired on multiple commercial ships in August, and U.S. Central Command struck three Iranian oil tankers near the Kharg Island export hub. Despite the fighting, crude is still reaching the market and Iraq's exports rose in August, but analysts expect prices to stay elevated while tankers face attack risk. The oil spike is a key driver of this week's climb in bond yields and renewed inflation worries weighing on the Fed and the ECB. ANZ raised its short-term Brent forecast to $95, with upside risk if the conflict widens.
news.detailZh: 美国本周对伊朗发起新一轮打击，此前双方相对平静约一个月，德黑兰随后以打击美军基地和过境霍尔木兹海峡的船只作为报复。伊朗8月向多艘商船开火，美军中央司令部则在卡尔格岛出口枢纽附近打击了三艘伊朗油轮。尽管冲突持续，原油仍在流向市场，伊拉克8月出口还有所增加，但分析师预计只要油轮面临袭击风险，油价就会维持高位。此轮油价飙升是本周债券收益率上升和通胀担忧重燃的主因，正对美联储和欧洲央行构成压力。澳新银行将短期布伦特预测上调至95美元，若冲突扩大还有上行风险。

news.titleEn: Euro zone inflation is back above 3%, and higher interest rates are likely to follow
news.conclusionEn: Euro area annual inflation accelerated to 3.3% in August from 2.9% in July — the highest since September 2023 — driven by a roughly 14% surge in energy prices, and markets moved to fully price a 25-basis-point ECB rate hike to 2.5%.
news.conclusionZh: 欧元区8月通胀升至3.3%，市场押注欧央行加息25个基点。
news.whyEn: An ECB hike would be its first tightening in years, raising borrowing costs for households and governments across the bloc and adding to the global upward move in bond yields.
news.whyZh: 欧央行若加息将是多年来首次收紧，抬高欧元区借贷成本并推升全球收益率。
news.detailEn: Energy inflation jumped to about 14.3%, its highest since January 2023, on the Middle East-driven rise in oil and gas prices, while services inflation eased to 3.0% and core inflation edged down to 2.4%. Among the largest economies, Spanish inflation hit 4.5%, Italy 3.2%, Germany 2.9% and France 2.7%. The reading complicates the ECB's task because underlying price pressures are cooling even as the headline rate climbs on volatile energy. A September move would align the ECB with a broader central-bank shift toward guarding against a second inflation wave. The next euro-zone flash estimate and the ECB meeting will be closely watched.
news.detailZh: 受中东局势推高油气价格影响，能源通胀跳升至约14.3%，为2023年1月以来最高；服务业通胀回落至3.0%，核心通胀小幅降至2.4%。主要经济体中，西班牙通胀达4.5%、意大利3.2%、德国2.9%、法国2.7%。这一数据令欧央行处境复杂：总体通胀因能源波动走高，但潜在价格压力其实在降温。9月若加息，将使欧央行与更广泛的央行转向一致，即防范第二波通胀。下一次欧元区快报和欧央行会议将受到密切关注。

news.titleEn: Nvidia agrees to buy Hugging Face for almost $13 billion in AI expansion
news.conclusionEn: Nvidia signed a definitive agreement on Sept. 2 to acquire the open-source AI platform Hugging Face for about $12.93 billion, plus an equity retention pool of up to $1 billion for staff, in its second-largest acquisition ever.
news.conclusionZh: 英伟达约129亿美元收购开源AI平台Hugging Face。
news.whyEn: The deal hands Nvidia the leading hub where more than 18 million developers share AI models and datasets, deepening its grip on the AI software stack and likely inviting antitrust scrutiny.
news.whyZh: 英伟达借此掌控全球最大开源模型社区，强化AI软件生态主导地位，或引反垄断审查。
news.detailEn: Hugging Face hosts more than 3 million models and is used by over 200,000 companies, making it a central piece of open-source AI infrastructure. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said the platform will 'remain an open platform for the entire AI ecosystem,' and Hugging Face's chief told CNBC his company approached Huang weeks before the deal. The transaction is expected to close in the first half of 2027, subject to regulatory approval in the U.S. and abroad. It follows Nvidia's roughly $20 billion purchase of Groq assets late last year and signals a push to control software and community, not just chips. Rivals and regulators are likely to question whether the dominant AI-chip maker owning the main model hub concentrates too much power.
news.detailZh: Hugging Face托管超过300万个模型，逾20万家公司使用，是开源AI基础设施的核心一环。英伟达CEO黄仁勋表示该平台将「继续作为面向整个AI生态的开放平台」，Hugging Face负责人向CNBC透露是其公司在交易前数周主动接触黄仁勋。交易预计2027年上半年完成，须获美国及海外监管批准。此前英伟达去年底以约200亿美元收购Groq资产，此番收购显示其意在掌控软件与社区，而不只是芯片。竞争对手和监管机构可能质疑，主导AI芯片的厂商再拥有主要模型平台是否过度集中权力。

news.titleEn: Witkoff and Kushner take U.S. peace push to Kyiv after meeting Putin in Moscow
news.conclusionEn: U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner held about three hours of talks with President Vladimir Putin at the Kremlin before travelling to Kyiv, with Putin ordering a three-day halt on strikes against the Ukrainian capital during the visit.
news.conclusionZh: 美方特使会晤普京约三小时后转赴基辅，推动结束乌克兰战争。
news.whyEn: It is the most substantive U.S.-Russia diplomatic contact in months and could shape any ceasefire framework, though Kyiv and European capitals fear a deal that pressures Ukraine into territorial concessions.
news.whyZh: 这是数月来美俄最实质接触，或左右停火框架，但基辅担心被迫让步领土。
news.detailEn: Putin described the situation around Ukraine as 'difficult' but said Russia was ready to present its position and keep contacts with Washington. He met the envoys over an afternoon session followed by dinner, and paused attacks on Kyiv for three days from midnight Saturday to coincide with their onward trip. Zelensky has called for a broader halt to air attacks and wants firm security guarantees before any settlement. European leaders worry the U.S. proposal could lock in Russian control of occupied territory. No breakthrough was announced, and the talks in Kyiv will test whether the two sides are close enough to move toward a formal ceasefire.
news.detailZh: 普京称乌克兰局势「困难」，但表示俄方愿阐明立场并继续与华盛顿接触。他与美方特使先举行下午会谈，随后共进晚餐，并从周六午夜起对基辅暂停打击三天，以配合其随后的行程。泽连斯基呼吁更全面地停止空袭，并希望在任何和解前获得可靠的安全保证。欧洲领导人担心美方方案可能固化俄罗斯对占领区的控制。会谈未宣布突破，基辅的后续磋商将检验双方是否已接近推进正式停火。

news.titleEn: Days after Trump announces Venezuela oil deal, White House fills in some of the details
news.conclusionEn: The White House said a private firm, North American Blue Energy Partners, received 100-year concessions for 17 Venezuelan oil fields holding about 65 billion barrels of reserves, giving a U.S. government office a 35% equity stake and the State Department the right to buy 20% of output at production cost.
news.conclusionZh: 白宫披露委内瑞拉石油协议细节，涉及约650亿桶储量。
news.whyEn: The arrangement would sharply expand U.S.-linked oil reserves and could aid Strategic Petroleum Reserve refills, but analysts say reviving Venezuela's run-down output will take years and critics call the terms exploitative.
news.whyZh: 协议大幅扩充美国可控石油储量，但恢复委产能需数年，且条款受批评。
news.detailEn: The deal follows a U.S. military operation in Venezuela and a period of pressure on Caracas, and the White House frames it as boosting supply and lowering gas prices for Americans at no taxpayer cost. Independent experts told outlets including Fortune and the Washington Post that Venezuela's oil sector is badly degraded after years of underinvestment and sanctions, so new barrels would arrive slowly. Critics, including some in Congress and rights groups, have questioned the legality and the optics of a foreign government's assets being steered to a private company with U.S. equity attached. The structure also raises questions about how a future administration or Venezuelan government could unwind it. Oil markets have largely shrugged, focusing instead on the Middle East risk premium.
news.detailZh: 该协议出台前，美国曾在委内瑞拉展开军事行动并对加拉加斯施压；白宫称此举可增加供应、压低美国油价，且不花纳税人的钱。《财富》《华盛顿邮报》等援引独立专家指出，委石油行业经多年投资不足和制裁已严重退化，新增产量将缓慢到来。包括部分国会议员和人权组织在内的批评者质疑其合法性，以及将他国资产导向一家附带美国股权的私人公司的观感。这一架构也令人担忧未来的美国政府或委内瑞拉政府如何撤销。油市反应平淡，焦点仍在中东风险溢价。

news.titleEn: Tesla's stock drops 6% as Cybercab update 'underwhelms,' NHTSA opens probe
news.conclusionEn: Tesla shares fell about 5.9% on Sept. 4 after a private Austin event left key autonomy and pricing questions unanswered, and the U.S. NHTSA opened an audit query into whether the Cybercab was correctly self-certified as safe for public roads.
news.conclusionZh: Cybercab发布会令华尔街失望，特斯拉股价跌约6%。
news.whyEn: Tesla's valuation leans heavily on its robotaxi story, so weak execution plus a fresh regulatory review raises doubts about the timeline for meaningful driverless revenue.
news.whyZh: 特斯拉估值高度依赖robotaxi前景，执行不力叠加监管审查令商业化时间承压。
news.detailEn: Executives spoke for about 15 minutes on pricing, manufacturing and technology, and CEO Elon Musk did not attend, according to people there. The stock had risen 5.4% the day before in anticipation, so the drop erased those gains. Wells Fargo analysts said Tesla's Austin robotaxi service is 'facing early execution issues,' citing user complaints about routing errors, missed stops and long waits. The NHTSA query asks whether Tesla properly certified that the Cybercab meets federal motor-vehicle safety standards, a step that could slow a wider rollout. Investors now want concrete milestones on vehicle production, safety approvals and paid rides rather than demonstrations.
news.detailZh: 据在场人士称，高管就定价、制造和技术讲了约15分钟，CEO马斯克未出席。发布会前一日股价因预期上涨5.4%，此次下跌抹去了涨幅。富国银行分析师称特斯拉在奥斯汀的robotaxi服务「面临早期执行问题」，用户抱怨路线错误、漏站和长时间等待。美国国家公路交通安全管理局的核查询问特斯拉是否已妥善认证Cybercab符合联邦机动车安全标准，这一步骤可能拖慢更大规模的推广。投资者现在希望看到整车产量、安全审批和付费载客的具体里程碑，而非演示。

news.titleEn: Philippines Vice President Sara Duterte posts bail after arrest warrant
news.conclusionEn: Philippine Vice President Sara Duterte posted 360,000 pesos (about $5,740) bail on three counts of 'grave threats' after a Quezon City court ordered her arrest over remarks that she had arranged to have President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. killed if she were harmed.
news.conclusionZh: 菲副总统莎拉·杜特尔特因威胁总统案获准保释。
news.whyEn: The case deepens the rupture between the Marcos and Duterte camps that jointly won the 2022 election and feeds into Duterte's impeachment trial, a guilty verdict in which could bar her from office.
news.whyZh: 案件加剧马科斯与杜特尔特两大阵营决裂，并牵动或致其下台的弹劾审判。
news.detailEn: Duterte made the comments in a late-night briefing, saying she had instructed someone to kill the president, the first lady and a congressman cousin if she herself were killed; she later said the remarks were misconstrued and denied wrongdoing. She appeared voluntarily before the court, so no physical arrest was needed. The dispute between the two most powerful political families in the Philippines has escalated since their alliance collapsed, spanning the impeachment case, budget fights and drug-war investigations. The episode adds political uncertainty in a treaty ally of the United States that sits on the front line of South China Sea tensions. Her Senate impeachment trial remains the bigger threat to her career.
news.detailZh: 杜特尔特在一场深夜简报中称，若自己被杀，她已指示他人杀害总统、第一夫人及一名担任议员的堂亲；她后来称言论被曲解并否认不当行为。她主动到庭，因此无需实际逮捕。菲律宾两大政治家族的联盟破裂后，双方矛盾持续升级，涉及弹劾案、预算之争和禁毒战调查。作为美国的条约盟友、地处南海紧张前线的国家，此事增添了政治不确定性。对她政治前途更大的威胁仍是参议院的弹劾审判。

businessTips.explanationEn: The Kano Model sorts product or service features by how they affect customer satisfaction: 'basic' expectations that anger people when missing but earn no praise when present, 'performance' attributes where more is linearly better, and 'delighters' that surprise customers positively. It helps teams avoid over-investing in things customers take for granted and spot cheap changes that build outsized goodwill. Categories drift over time, because today's delighter becomes tomorrow's baseline expectation.
businessTips.explanationZh: 卡诺模型按功能对客户满意度的影响将其分类：「基本型」是缺了会让人生气、有了也不会加分的期望；「期望型」是做得越多、满意度越高的属性；「兴奋型」是能带来惊喜的加分项。它帮助团队避免在客户视为理所当然的地方过度投入，并找出成本低却能大幅提升好感的改动。分类会随时间漂移，今天的兴奋型会变成明天的基本型。
businessTips.exampleEn: A hotel's clean sheets are 'basic' — nobody praises them, but their absence ruins the stay. Fast check-in is a 'performance' attribute: quicker is always better. A free handwritten welcome note is a 'delighter' that costs little and earns reviews — until every competitor does it and guests start expecting it.
businessTips.exampleZh: 酒店干净的床单属于「基本型」——没人会夸，但缺了就毁掉整趟入住；快速办理入住是「期望型」，越快越好；手写的欢迎便条是「兴奋型」，成本很低却能换来好评——直到所有竞品都这么做，客人开始视其为标配。

businessTips.explanationEn: Pre-selling means taking real orders or paid deposits for a product before you build it or stock it. Unlike surveys or waitlists, money actually changing hands is hard evidence that demand is real and your price is acceptable. It also funds the first production run and surfaces objections while they are still cheap to fix. The main risk is delivery: you must be able to refund cleanly and ship within the window you promised, or you burn trust.
businessTips.explanationZh: 预售是指在产品做出来或备货之前，就收取真实订单或付费定金。与问卷或候补名单不同，真金白银的成交是需求真实、定价可接受的硬证据。它还能为首批生产提供资金，并在异议还容易解决时就把它暴露出来。主要风险在交付：你必须能干净地退款，并在承诺的时间窗内发货，否则会损耗信任。
businessTips.exampleEn: A designer posts three tote-bag prints and opens a two-week pre-order at $35 each with a stated ship date six weeks out. Two designs pass 50 orders and go into production; the third gets four orders and is cancelled with full refunds, saving the cost of unsold stock and revealing which idea to pursue.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位设计师放出三款帆布袋印花，开启为期两周的预售，每款35美元，并注明六周后发货。两款订单超过50单，进入生产；第三款只有4单，全额退款并取消，既省下滞销库存成本，也看清了该主推哪个方向。

businessTips.explanationEn: Duration measures how much a bond's price moves when interest rates change, expressed in years. A bond with a duration of 8 falls roughly 8% in price if yields rise by one percentage point, and rises about 8% if yields fall. Longer maturities and lower coupons mean higher duration and bigger swings. It lets an investor compare the interest-rate sensitivity of very different bonds using a single number.
businessTips.explanationZh: 久期衡量利率变动时债券价格的波动幅度，以年为单位表示。久期为8的债券，在收益率上升1个百分点时价格大约下跌8%，收益率下降时则大约上涨8%。期限越长、票息越低，久期越高，波动越大。它让投资者用一个数字就能比较差异很大的债券对利率的敏感度。
businessTips.exampleEn: This week's jump in long-term government bond yields is exactly why long-duration bond funds fell sharply: a 30-year bond fund might have a duration near 17, so a 0.3-point rise in yields knocks about 5% off its value, while a short-term fund with a duration of 2 barely moves.
businessTips.exampleZh: 本周长期国债收益率跳升，正是长久期债券基金大跌的原因：一只30年期债券基金的久期可能接近17，收益率上升0.3个百分点，其净值就会缩水约5%；而久期为2的短债基金几乎不动。
